findings.title: Document Worker-side restart branches alongside Control reservation states
findings.body: COM-003 remains incomplete: a reserved Control envelope without a result does not determine whether Worker executes, replays, or rejects it. At HEAD, native-attempt-executor.ts:24–35 reads cached receipts and invokes recovery before launch; native-attempt-recovery.ts:25–43 reconstructs archived results or seals interrupted attempts without relaunching. native-attempt-journal.ts:161–170 bypasses new-admission validation for historical records, whereas native-attempt-executor.ts:75–77 rejects expired claims for new admission. Document these distinctions and their stop conditions beside this row. Otherwise an operator reconciling an old reservation cannot distinguish historical replay from expired, never-admitted work. The source-only test worker-native-journal.test.mts:20–35 explicitly distinguishes new-admission rejection from historical replay.

findings.title: Include spawn queue pressure and its separate timing boundary
findings.body: The Forge/Echo timing description covers polling but omits the producer queue that precedes it. openclaw.ts:187–207 serializes spawns by endpoint/controller session and waits spawnIntervalMs after each operation; openclaw-config.ts:65 defaults that interval to 1,500 ms. This promise chain has no queue-length ceiling. The session timeout begins inside pollSession (openclaw-session.ts:223–230), after spawning, so it does not bound queue residence or spawn time. Document queue ordering, the absence of a queue ceiling, and the caller/declaration deadline that can stop queued work. These are substantive missing COM-004/COM-012 pressure and timeout rules, rather than provider behavior that must remain unknown.

findings.title: Specify the independent cleanup budget and signal rules
findings.body: Calling this merely a bounded cleanup scope leaves the Core deadline/abort model incomplete for COM-005 and COM-012. adapter-startup.ts:106–114 constructs the scope using platform shutdownTimeoutMs; adapter-invocation-phase.ts:32–58 permits it once and combines its own timeout with adapter lifecycle cancellation, rather than the already-aborted invocation signal. adapter-startup.ts:127–140 preserves the original invocation authority while substituting that cleanup signal. State the configuration source, single-use rule, lifecycle abort, timeout/error outcomes, and separation from the normal attempt deadline. This distinction explains how cancellation can still reach Gateway and when termination proof becomes unresolved. adapter-cleanup-scope.test.mts:39–84 contains the corresponding timeout, lifecycle, authorization, and reuse cases.

findings.title: Describe stage-result fields using the validating schema branches
findings.body: The new summary presents reason as an optional common field, but the actual passed branch prohibits it: plugin-system-v2.schema.json:609–624 sets additionalProperties=false and permits only schemaVersion, outcome, artifacts, and facts. A plugin following the summary and returning passed with reason fails validation and becomes core.plugin_runtime_failed/retry (stage-executor.ts:43–47,132–140). Clarify that passed forbids reason, while every other branch requires it, and cite the validating union at schema lines 609–675. The linked generated ResultBase at contracts.ts:509–525 is broader than the accepted result union and cannot establish those constraints.

overall_explanation:
Whole-obligation decisions: COM-003 NOT_READY: Control restart coverage omits the distinct Worker replay/recovery/new-admission branches (native-attempt-executor.ts:24–35,75–77; native-attempt-recovery.ts:25–43). COM-004 NOT_READY: protocol variants and result-import selection are substantially covered, but spawn queue ordering/pressure and pre-poll timing remain absent (openclaw.ts:187–207; openclaw-session.ts:223–230). COM-005 NOT_READY: the stage-result summary contradicts the validating passed branch, and the independent cleanup abort/budget contract is missing (plugin-system-v2.schema.json:609–675; adapter-invocation-phase.ts:32–58). COM-012 NOT_READY: the central model still omits those implemented queue and cleanup rules.

sourceAccuracy: NOT_READY because the new result-field summary admits a schema-invalid passed result. readerUsability: NOT_READY because restart and cancellation decisions still require reconstructing omitted source branches. quality: NOT_READY for the incomplete whole obligations above; the additions otherwise substantially improve protocol, isolation, and observer coverage.

Prior accepted scopes: COM-002 impact PASS; COM-006 impact PASS; COM-007 impact PASS. The additions and verification metadata do not contradict or weaken those accepted facets. COM-001/008/009/010/011 remain explicitly open; this review accepts no additional obligations. Native runtime/effect behavior and unknown external identities remain unproven. Inspection was source-only; no product, render, cluster, native, or test execution was performed.
